key_expressions: Do you have any plans today?,

A: What time should we meet today?
Then how about 3 p.m.?
Great! See you then!
B: Hmm… the afternoon works better for me!
Oh, 3 p.m. sounds perfect!
Yes, let’s meet at that time!

A: Do you have any plans today?
Oh, I see! Then is lunch possible?
Great! Let’s meet at noon!
B: Yeah, I’m a bit busy this morning.
Lunch works for me!
Okay, see you at 12!

A: Are you free this weekend?
Nice! Saturday afternoon works for me!
Okay! Let’s meet on Saturday!
B: Yeah, I have some free time on the weekend.
That sounds good to me!
Great! I’m looking forward to it!

A: Do you have a moment to talk now?
Oh, great! How many minutes do you have?
Okay, I’ll call you right now!
B: Yeah, I have a little bit of time.
I can spare around ten minutes.
Alright, I’ll wait for your call!

A: When are you free next week?
Oh! That afternoon works for me!
Then I’ll schedule it!
B: Tuesday should be okay for me.
Great, I’ll keep my afternoon free!
Okay, see you then!

A: Are you free this evening?
Oh, really? Then what about tomorrow?
Great! I’ll message you tomorrow evening!
B: I think I’ll finish late today.
Tomorrow evening is fine!
Sounds good! See you then!

A: Is tomorrow morning possible for you?
Ah, I see! Then how about the afternoon?
Perfect! I’ll see you in the afternoon!
B: I already have an appointment in the morning.
The afternoon is free for me!
Great! That works well!

A: What time does the meeting start today?
Oh! I might be a few minutes late.
Okay! I’ll get there as quickly as I can!
B: It starts at 3 p.m.
Five minutes should be fine!
Alright! See you soon.

A: What are you doing this evening?
Oh! I’m free at that time too!
Then let’s go for a walk together!
B: I’m planning to take a short walk.
Great! See you then!
Sure! I love evening walks!

A: How was your day?
Oh, you still did well today!
I hope tomorrow is even better!
B: I was a bit tired.
Yeah, but I’m okay now.
Thank you! I’ll try my best tomorrow!
